# Wall fixing

Tall storage furniture must be secured with the supplied anti-tip restraint. Wall materials differ, so the supplied product pack may not contain the correct wall plug for every home. Customers who are uncertain should use a qualified installer.

# Placement

Keep furniture level and away from direct heat or persistent moisture. Do not allow children to climb shelves or open multiple loaded drawers at once. Product-specific instructions take priority over general guidance. Stop assembly if parts are missing or damaged and contact support.
